home.subtitle: Burnt Almond Fudge. Canadian Vanilla. Caramel Cashew. Malted Milk. The 1929 Legacy Flight starts here.

flavors.name: Apple Pie a la Mode
flavors.description: Apple pie ice cream seasoned with cinnamon and sprinkled with chunks of graham cracker pie crust.

flavors.name: Pumpkin Pie
flavors.description: Creamy pumpkin spice ice cream swirled with warm cinnamon and nutmeg, packed with crunchy Biscoff cookie pieces for a buttery, spiced finish.

flavors.name: Coconut Horchata
flavors.description: Dairy-free coconut horchata ice cream infused with cinnamon and vanilla, delivering a rich, refreshing twist on the classic Mexican favorite.

scoops.name: Bear Lake Raspberry
scoops.description: Made with real Bear Lake raspberries — bright, tart, and bursting with fresh fruit flavor. A Utah favorite.

scoops.name: Birthday Cake
scoops.description: Festive vanilla cake batter ice cream loaded with rainbow sprinkles and frosting swirls. Every day is a celebration.

scoops.name: Bluey
scoops.description: A vibrant blue vanilla ice cream that's as fun to look at as it is to eat. A kid favorite.

scoops.name: Brown Sugar Cookie Dough
scoops.description: Rich brown sugar ice cream loaded with chunks of buttery cookie dough. Warm, sweet, and irresistible.

scoops.name: Burnt Almond Fudge
scoops.description: The flavor that built a legacy. Velvety chocolate fudge ice cream swirled with hand-toasted almonds. A Snelgrove original since day one.

scoops.name: Canadian Vanilla
scoops.description: Laird Snelgrove's secret recipe, acquired from a Canadian contact and kept close ever since. Impossibly rich, impossibly smooth.

scoops.name: Caramel Cashew
scoops.description: Buttery caramel ice cream loaded with whole roasted cashews. Sweet, salty, and completely irresistible.

scoops.name: "Charles Rich" Chocolate
scoops.description: Named for our founder — a deep, pure chocolate ice cream made the way Charles would have wanted it.

scoops.name: Coconut Chocolate
scoops.description: Rich chocolate ice cream made with real coconut cream. Dairy-free, but you'd never know it.

scoops.name: Cookie Butter Biscoff
scoops.description: Creamy cookie butter ice cream swirled with crushed Biscoff cookies. Sweet, spiced, and totally addictive.

scoops.name: Cookies & Cream
scoops.description: Creamy vanilla ice cream loaded with generous chunks of chocolate cookie. A forever classic.

scoops.name: Cotton Candy
scoops.description: Sweet, whimsical cotton candy flavored ice cream in swirls of pink and blue. Pure carnival fun.

scoops.name: Fresh Strawberry
scoops.description: Bright, fresh strawberry ice cream made with real fruit. Light, summery, and refreshing.

scoops.name: Malted Milk
scoops.description: A nostalgic old-fashioned malt shop flavor — creamy, smooth, and wonderfully retro. Like a milkshake in a pint.

scoops.name: Rainbow Sherbet
scoops.description: A colorful trio of raspberry, orange, and lemon sherbet. Light, fruity, and refreshing.

scoops.name: Rocky Road
scoops.description: Chocolate ice cream loaded with soft marshmallows, whole cashews, and chocolate chips. A timeless crowd-pleaser.

scoops.name: Salted Peanut Butter Oreo
scoops.description: Salted peanut butter ice cream swirled with Oreo cookie pieces. Sweet, salty, crunchy — endlessly snackable.

scoops.name: Triple Chocolate Brownie
scoops.description: Triple chocolate intensity — chocolate ice cream, chocolate chips, and fudgy brownie bites throughout. For the true chocolate lover.

scoops.name: Vicki's Mint Brownie
scoops.description: Creamy mint ice cream packed with chewy fudgy brownie chunks. Cool, rich, and completely refreshing.
